name: Lesser Death

items.name: Scythe
items.description: Derived from a farming tool used to mow down long grains and cereals, this weapon has a long wooden shaft with protruding handles, capped with a curved blade set at a right angle.

generalAbilities.name: Death's Grace
generalAbilities.description: The lesser death can choose whether or not it counts as undead for effects that affect undead differently. Even if it does not count as undead, the lesser death still never counts as a living creature.

generalAbilities.name: Status Sight
generalAbilities.description: The Lesser Death automatically knows the Hit Points, conditions, afflictions, and emotions of all creatures it can see.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Aura of Misfortune
defensiveAbilities.description:
20 feet.

Living creatures in the aura must roll twice on all d20 rolls and use the lower result.

Effect: Aura of Misfortune

defensiveAbilities.name: Lurking Death
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 60 feet makes a ranged attack or uses an action that has the concentrate, manipulate, or move trait

Effect The lesser death teleports to a square adjacent to the triggering creature and makes a melee Strike against it. If the Strike hits, the lesser death disrupts the triggering action.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
A lesser death can choose whether or not it takes vitality damage.

See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Infuse Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description: Any scythe gains the agile trait, can't be disarmed, and becomes a +2 greater striking keen scythe while the lesser death wields it.

lv2spells.name: See the Unseen (Constant)
lv2spells.description:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds Invisible creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them Concealed and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

lv6spells.name: Truesight (Constant)
lv6spells.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).
